verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a software-backed immigration service platform, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public repository, published source code, or an open-source license. The materials describe only proprietary managed services and an in-platform case tracker, and the probes found just an llms.txt file and no OpenAPI spec, neither of which is about source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
